newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Mechmar plans rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Mechmar plans rights issue.

text.p: Mechmar Corp Bhd has proposed a one-for-two rights issue of 34.62 million new shares at 2.80 ringgit per share.

In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, Mechmar said the proposed rights issue "will assist the company to meet its funding obligations for investment in Independent Power Tanzania Ltd and provide working capital for the group".
Mechmar had earlier entered into a joint venture to construct and operate a 100-megawatt power station in Tanzania.

Mechmar has also proposed an executive share option scheme (ESOS) for eligible employees and executive directors of the group of up to 10 percent of its issued share capital, and to double its authorised share capital to 200 million ringgit.
Mechmar said its paid-up capital will increase to 114.26 million ringgit from the existing 69.25 million upon completion of the rights issue and full exercise of the ESOS.
The company is involved in manufacturing, property development and fabrication for oil and gas industries. The stock closed at 3.14 ringgit on Friday. ($1 = 2.5 ringgit)
